The count covers 21 principal prose/formula baselines, including the crossed introduction line; interlinear insertions, marginal numbers and drawing labels are inventoried separately.

legibility: The main handwriting is dark with broad spacing, and most prose and active formulas can be followed in the prepared halves. Medial cursive joins are compressed in several words. The crossed introduction, the cancelled argument, and the words beneath origine and réseau retain genuine letter uncertainty; de also retains uncertainty in cancellation scope. The radical attachment is clearly exposed, while the denominator in the following parenthesized expression has a compressed 3-like return. The lattice drawing has strong labels and six clear ringed points, with darker radii crossing much lighter construction traces; several thin junctions cannot be followed continuously beneath those crossings. The opening colon and the group’s lowered position are supported by their crops. C and H agree on much of the prose, but H’s definite à, raised wedge group, Construction period and shortened or unnamed cancelled readings are adjusted or retained as doubts according to this page. Both witnesses’ expanded euclidean word is replaced by a local contracted/full alternative. The final V_S and Γ_S forms are preserved exactly at their written positions.
notes:
L01 names Courbes ell. anharmoniques de type hexagonal, with ell. added above the line. L02–L04 present the category wording and describe oriented hexagons as torseurs S under the following written group; the source has équivalente : and no inserted est. L05–L10 give the group and ring expressions, including the cancelled line, the radical’s lower ζ annotation and the doubtful final denominator. These are reported source claims and notation, not a checked equivalence or a new theorem. The left drawing is reproduced from its visible strokes: six inner ringed points, further filled marks, two exposed heavy directed radii, a heavy top edge with an unresolved endpoint interpretation, dotted strokes and pale exterior constructions. The crossed introduction below it remains On pourra|On pose, with On pose inserted above. L12–L13 write the two elliptic formulas. L14–L19 describe an oriented Euclidean realization of the combinatorial hexagon, give its barycenter as origin, name the generated réseau with V_S in the prose, and then write X_S=Eℓ_1(S) ≃ V_S/Γ_S. The prose and formula letter choices are retained without correction. L20–L21 state that the oriented Euclidean structure supplies the complex structure; this is an attribution to the manuscript, not an independently checked mathematical result. No proof or computation was performed. Whole scan and both prepared halves were inspected, then all fifteen tight crops. Some neighboring descenders enter narrow text regions, so neutral blind-box scopes explicitly identify the target baseline and exclude crossing context. The heading and network boxes extend beyond the initial crop bounds to include complete exposed ascenders/descenders already seen in the whole/half views; no decided locus was recropped. Every handwritten numeral, insertion, cancellation, source/current doubtful formula and C/H lexical disagreement has a localized complete target.
Blind audit: the compressed comb. and the first relation in the final quotient now retain local alternatives. The canceled word under origine retains centre|avec, and the raised position of étant remains explicitly uncertain. The lattice drawing retains all first-read exterior marks and receives the additional small white apertures and exposed returns described in the audit.
